official.deadline_note: The 2026 round closed at 2:00 p.m. on 27 March 2026; the digitalised admission letter had a separate, later deadline of 8 May 2026 (2:00 p.m.) and could only be sent through the Banco de la Republica's Sistema de Atencion a la Ciudadania. Results were published on 12 June 2026. The plastic-arts line states its call opens in the second half of 2026.
official.application_cycle: 2026 cycle (convocatoria 2026): applications opened 1 December 2025 and closed 27 March 2026
official.status_note: The published 2026 round has concluded: applications closed 27 March 2026 and the Bank has published 'Ganadores(as) convocatoria 2026' for the economics/public-administration/public-policy line, the economic-law line and the young-talent music line. No 2027 round is published yet. The plastic-arts line states 'La apertura de esta convocatoria sera en el segundo semestre de 2026'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Matricula, derechos de registro, inscripcion y grado (valor total).
official.funding_period: per year, paid in two instalments (January and July)
benefits: Matricula, derechos de registro, inscripcion y grado (valor total).
Nivelacion del idioma (1 mes y hasta USD 3.000).
Sostenimiento anual de USD 39.102 (Se dividira en dos giros pagaderos en enero y julio).
Pasajes de ida y regreso en clase economica (valor total) - published on the economic-law and music lines.
Denominacion honorifica 'Lauchlin Currie' (doctorate in Economics) or 'Enrique Low Murtra' (Economic Law), which does not represent additional economic benefits.
eligibility: Ser colombiano y mayor de edad al momento de postularse a la convocatoria.

Acreditar titulo profesional; for the economic-law line a professional degree in Derecho, for the music line a degree in a discipline related to Musica with a demonstrated trajectory in the regional or national artistic milieu.
Contar con carta de admision en las universidades incluidas en el listado aprobado por el Banco de la Republica (approved reference list of universities and programmes for each line).
En caso de que el programa se curse en los Estados Unidos, contar con Visa J1.
The music line is not aimed at students who are currently studying or have already studied postgraduate studies abroad, and applicants may not be employees of the Banco de la Republica.

Each line is discipline-restricted: doctorate in Economics (up to the fourth year), master's in Public Administration or Public Policy, postgraduate in Economic Law (master's or doctorate, up to the second or fourth year according to the programme), Musica (composition, conducting - choral or orchestral - and performance including instruments and voice), and Artes Plasticas (painting, sculpture, printmaking, drawing, photography, performance, installations, new digital media and audiovisual/electronic technology).
requirements: Admission to, or application for, a formal postgraduate programme at a foreign university of recognised academic excellence that appears on the Bank's approved reference list for the line.
Only official degrees are funded: 'No se tendran en cuenta las postulaciones para titulo propio solo para titulo oficial.'
J1 visa if the programme is studied in the United States.
The study programme must start in the call year and the beneficiary must travel to the destination country in that same year.

After graduating, the beneficiary must return to Colombia and amortise the patronage through service in an entity accredited by the Banco de la Republica (public entities, universities and non-profit private entities dedicated to research in the area of study).
documents: Cedula de ciudadania ampliada al 150% por anverso y reverso (front and back, data legible).
Acta de grado o diploma de pregrado y, si aplica, de posgrado.
Certificado de notas de pregrado y, si aplica, de posgrado, showing all grades obtained, including failed or deferred ones.
Carta de admision expedida por universidades incluidas en el listado aprobado por el Banco de la Republica.
Programa(s) de estudio(s) en lo(s) cual(es) se postula, with the detail of subjects, practicals and other requirements that guarantee the obtaining of the degree.
Dos cartas de presentacion en formato del Banco de la Republica, each issued by a university teacher or research tutor of the candidate, with a screenshot supporting the sending of each letter.
[Optional] Carta de presentacion laboral en formato del Banco de la Republica issued by the candidate's last employer, with supporting screenshot.
[Optional] Certificados o diplomas de premios o distinciones, and the link to publications authored by the candidate, distinguishing those with peer review and indexed.

Music line only: copies of concert programmes in which the candidate has taken part, a link to a recent digital recording made within the six months before registration (not shorter than half an hour, with clear solo participation), a written programme of the works to be performed in a private audition, certificates of prizes and distinctions, and optional press reviews.
selection_criteria: Outstanding academic merits and, for the arts lines, demonstrated artistic merits and qualities.

Selection is carried out by a jury made up of a Banco de la Republica executive and four further members who may be directors, deans, professors of public or private universities, or recognised researchers and artists.

The seven annual places are distributed by the Bank's own methodology: three to applicants accepted in the top 20 doctoral programmes in economics, two to applicants accepted in the listed master's programmes in public administration or public policy, and any remaining places reassigned in the order set out by the Bank.
coverage: Matricula, derechos de registro, inscripcion y grado (valor total).
Nivelacion del idioma (1 mes y hasta USD 3.000).
Sostenimiento anual de USD 39.102, divided into two instalments payable in January and July.
Pasajes de ida y regreso en clase economica (valor total) - economic-law and music lines only; the 2026 economics line page does not list airfare.
application_method: Paso 1: cree una cuenta para ingresar a la plataforma Patrocinio posgrados (email, country code, mobile number, password and acceptance of the data-processing policy; verification codes are sent by email and SMS).
Paso 2: diligencie los formularios de informacion Personal, Academica, Laboral y Programa a realizar (up to three programmes) and cargue los documentos en formato PDF.
Paso 3: pulse 'Enviar solicitud' y luego 'Confirmar', and check the registered mailbox for the confirmation message from noreplyestudios@posgrados.banrep.gov.co.
official.application_route: Apply online through the Banco de la Republica's 'Patrocinio posgrados' platform; the admission letter is sent later, separately, through the Sistema de Atencion a la Ciudadania.
official.citizenship_residency: Ser colombiano y mayor de edad al momento de postularse a la convocatoria; Banco de la Republica employees may not apply (music line), and the music line excludes those currently studying or already holding a postgraduate degree abroad.
official.international_eligibility: Not open to non-Colombians: the published requirement is Colombian nationality and legal age at the time of application.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Discipline-restricted by line, and restricted to the Bank's approved university/programme reference lists: doctorate in Economics; master's in Public Administration or Public Policy; postgraduate in Economic Law (requires a professional degree in Law); Musica; and Artes Plasticas.
official.research_requirement: No research proposal is required; the economics and economic-law lines require two presentation letters from a university teacher or research tutor of the candidate, and indexed peer-reviewed publications may be submitted optionally.
official.duration: Doctorate in Economics: up to a maximum of the fourth year of the programme abroad. Postgraduate in Economic Law: up to the second or fourth year according to the programme. Music: the patronage covers a maximum of two years of study.
official.description: El Banco de la Republica patrocina programas de posgrado en universidades extranjeras de reconocida excelencia academica, con el objetivo de aportar al desarrollo del pais mediante el fomento del conocimiento y la investigacion y de contribuir a la formacion de profesionales colombianos para que el pais cuente con un mayor numero de profesores, investigadores, funcionarios publicos y artistas altamente capacitados. Cada ano el patrocinio ofrece 7 cupos destinados a igual numero de profesionales colombianos que deseen estudiar un posgrado en el exterior y que, al graduarse, retornen al pais para retribuir el patrocinio y amortizarlo con servicios en alguna de las entidades avaladas por el Banco de la Republica.
official.program_type: Central-bank patronage programme (patrocinio) for overseas postgraduate study

The USD 39,102 annual sustenance figure, the tuition, insurance, language-levelling and airfare wording and the full 2026 calendar were each corroborated across three independent line pages and two capture dates. The 2022/2023 cycle pages were also read for comparison and are the source of the superseded benefit items listed under not_confirmed.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a central-bank patronage, not a scholarship: seven places a year for Colombian professionals, and the money is repaid through service in Colombia after graduation rather than kept as a grant. The published 2026 round closed on 27 March 2026 and winners were announced on 12 June 2026, so the realistic target is the next December-to-March window, while the plastic-arts line is announced to open in the second half of 2026. The package is strong on paper - full tuition and registration fees, USD 39,102 a year of living allowance in two instalments, a month of language levelling up to USD 3,000 and full medical insurance - but it is tied to admission at one of the Bank's own approved university lists, so the choice of foreign programme decides whether you can apply at all before merit ever comes into it.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Colombian professionals who can secure an admission letter at a listed foreign university in economics, public administration or policy, economic law, music or plastic arts, and who genuinely intend to come back and work in Colombia afterwards.
application_readiness_checklist: Before anything else, check whether your target programme and university appear on the Bank's approved reference list for your line; an unlisted programme cannot be funded no matter how strong the profile.
Confirm the degree is a titulo oficial, since the Bank states that applications for a titulo propio will not be considered.
If the programme is in the United States, begin the J1 visa process early: it is a stated requirement and the beneficiary carries the cost and the administration of obtaining it.

Brief two referees who have been your university teacher or research tutor and get them to complete the Bank's own presentation-letter format; you must upload a screenshot showing each referee sent the letter.
Get your cedula enlarged to 150% with front and back on the same page and legible data, and collect transcripts that show every grade obtained, including failed or deferred ones.
Prepare the study-programme document that details subjects, practicals and every requirement needed to obtain the degree, not just a course brochure.
common_rejection_risks: Incomplete files - the Bank states plainly that applications with incomplete documentation are not taken into account.
Filling the forms without actually submitting: you must press 'Enviar solicitud' and then 'Confirmar', and verify the confirmation email from noreplyestudios@posgrados.banrep.gov.co actually arrived.
Applying to a university or programme that is absent from the line's approved reference list.
Applying for a titulo propio rather than an official degree.
Arriving after the stated dates - the closing time was 2:00 p.m., not midnight.
For the music line, being excluded outright because you are already studying or hold a postgraduate degree abroad, or because you work for the Banco de la Republica.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The 2026 economics line list does not include airfare, and no line publishes book, thesis or installation allowances for 2026, so flights, books, thesis or production costs, visa fees and anything above the fixed USD 39,102 sustenance allowance (above the 5% uplift in the eleven named US cities) must be self-funded. Dependants' support, which was published in the 2022 cycle, is not covered in the 2026 pages.
document_audit: One single PDF per document type: if you hold two undergraduate diplomas they must be compiled into one file before upload.
No file may exceed 10 Mb, so scan the cedula and transcripts at a moderate resolution rather than maximum.
File naming is prescribed - 'Nombre del documento - Apellidos y nombres - Cedula' - and you must not use dots inside the identity number.
The two presentation letters must use the Bank's own format and each needs a screenshot proving the referee sent it; the optional employer letter has the same requirement.
The attached study programme must be detailed enough to show subject by subject how the degree is obtained; a marketing brochure is not enough.
alerts: The award is repayable in service: after graduating you must return to Colombia and work for an approved public body, university or non-profit, and the amortisation must be carried out from Colombian territory.

Serving outside Bogota and Cundinamarca during the repayment period earns a special benefit in the amortisation of your commitment - a real, published incentive worth weighing against staying in the capital.

The application deadline and the admission-letter deadline are different dates on different channels: 27 March 2026 for the platform, 8 May 2026 for the letter through the Sistema de Atencion a la Ciudadania.
The sustenance allowance is fixed, with a 5% uplift only for eleven named US cities, so expensive cities outside that list can leave a wide funding gap.
The study programme must start in the call year and you must travel to the destination country in that same year, which limits how late you can accept an overseas offer.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Create an account on the Patrocinio posgrados platform, complete the personal, academic, labour and programme forms (up to three programmes), upload the PDFs, then press 'Enviar solicitud' and 'Confirmar' and confirm the receipt email; the admission letter follows later through a separate channel.
